rows.grounds: numeral forming the count with the following noun
locative plural indicating the vast number in which the condition occurs
compound denoting the devices or realms of birth; locative plural of location
past passive participle describing those subjected to suffering

items.question: What suffering afflicts beings within the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms?
premises: The scope is eighty-four thousand in number.
Beings in these locations are tormented.
items.inference: Beings undergo torment throughout the vast multitude of eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is implied from context rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
